evidence.title: Is my cat overweight? How to help your pet lose weight safely

occurrences.checkable_against: Susan Rice interview and veterinary clinical literature on feline obesity
occurrences.quote_span: “Obesity in cats can lead to diabetes mellitus, as well as mobility problems,” Rice said.
occurrences.speaker: Susan Rice
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: veterinary studies comparing feline weight, metabolism and activity before and after sterilization
occurrences.quote_span: Weight gain is especially common after cats are spayed or neutered because hormonal changes can lower their metabolism and activity levels.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: veterinary weight-management monitoring protocols
occurrences.quote_span: Regular weigh-ins help veterinarians adjust portions and make sure the cat is losing fat without too much muscle.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: veterinary feline body-condition scoring guidelines
occurrences.quote_span: A healthy cat usually has a slight waist just in front of the hind legs, while sides that curve outward into a rounder shape may point to excess weight.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: cat food labels and veterinary nutrition guidance on feeding portions
occurrences.quote_span: Owners should check the calorie information on the food label rather than relying solely on the suggested serving size, which may be too generous.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: veterinary clinical records and literature on feline hepatic lipidosis
occurrences.quote_span: Rapid weight loss can cause hepatic lipidosis, or fatty liver disease, which can be fatal.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: veterinary feline weight-management feeding guidelines
occurrences.quote_span: Dry food can also work, but portions should be weighed carefully rather than left out for unlimited grazing.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: nutritional composition data on wet and dry cat foods
occurrences.quote_span: Wet food contains more water and is usually less calorie-dense, allowing some cats to eat a larger portion for the same number of calories.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: veterinary feline weight-loss treatment records and guidelines
occurrences.quote_span: Helping a cat slim down is a slow process, not a crash diet, and most cats will need several months to reach a healthier size.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: veterinary body-condition examination guidance
occurrences.quote_span: A normal pouch should feel loose and stretchy, while excess fat tends to feel firmer and more solid.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: Susan Rice interview or veterinary body-condition assessment guidance
occurrences.quote_span: “If you can’t easily feel rib bones, your cat is likely carrying extra fat.”
occurrences.speaker: Susan Rice
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: Kelly Yeo interview and veterinary feline nutrition guidance
occurrences.quote_span: “Two cats of the same weight can have quite different energy needs, so the plan must be adjusted according to what happens on the scales.”
occurrences.speaker: Kelly Yeo
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: Kelly Yeo interview or veterinary nutrition guidance
occurrences.quote_span: “A calorie calculation is only a starting point,” said Kelly Yeo, a small-animal veterinarian.
occurrences.speaker: Kelly Yeo
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: Kelly Yeo interview and veterinary nutrition treat-allocation guidelines
occurrences.quote_span: Yeo recommends keeping treats below 10% of a cat’s daily calories or using part of the regular food allowance as rewards.
occurrences.speaker: Kelly Yeo
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: veterinary feline calorie-accounting guidelines
occurrences.quote_span: Treats, table scraps and food used for medication count, too.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: veterinary feline nutrition guidelines
occurrences.quote_span: There is no one-size-fits-all calorie target for cats.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: Kelly Yeo interview and measured-versus-scooped cat-food portion data
occurrences.quote_span: Yeo recommends weighing food in grams with a digital kitchen scale because even a rounded scoop of calorie-dense kibble can add more calories than expected.
occurrences.speaker: Kelly Yeo
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: veterinary clinical studies on grooming and skin problems in overweight cats
occurrences.quote_span: Overweight cats may also have trouble reaching certain areas of their body, which can lead to skin and hygiene problems.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: Kelly Yeo interview and veterinary weight-management diet formulations/guidelines
occurrences.quote_span: For cats that need a larger calorie reduction, Yeo said a veterinary weight-management diet may be safer than simply serving much less of their usual food because it is formulated to provide adequate nutrients with fewer calories.
occurrences.speaker: Kelly Yeo
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: comparative veterinary studies of indoor-cat activity and obesity risk
occurrences.quote_span: Indoor cats may face an added challenge when their daily schedule includes far more napping than prowling.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: Susan Rice interview and veterinary clinical records on obesity-associated feline conditions
occurrences.quote_span: Rice said some cats may develop constipation, difficulty urinating or urinary tract infections when their size prevents them from grooming comfortably.
occurrences.speaker: Susan Rice
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: veterinary feline feeding studies and weight-management protocols
occurrences.quote_span: Some cats may do well with measured wet-food meals and a small amount of dry food in a puzzle toy or automatic feeder.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: Kelly Yeo interview and veterinary clinical nutrition literature
occurrences.quote_span: “Severe calorie restriction or sudden food refusal can create a major negative-energy balance.”
occurrences.speaker: Kelly Yeo
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: Susan Rice interview and veterinary records/studies on feline osteoarthritis
occurrences.quote_span: “The extra weight puts tremendous pressure on their joints and can definitely lead to painful osteoarthritis as the cat gets older.”
occurrences.speaker: Susan Rice
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: veterinary anatomy references on feline primordial pouches
occurrences.quote_span: Many cats have a primordial pouch, the loose skin that hangs near the hind legs, and it can be present even in a perfectly lean cat.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: veterinary emergency-care guidance for feline anorexia and hepatic lipidosis
occurrences.quote_span: So keep an eye our for habit changes and call a veterinarian if a cat stops eating, becomes lethargic, vomits, appears weak or develops yellowing around the eyes, gums or skin.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: Kelly Yeo interview and veterinary feline dieting guidelines
occurrences.quote_span: “Cats should never be placed on a crash diet,” Yeo said.
occurrences.speaker: Kelly Yeo
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: veterinary weight reference data and Susan Rice's statement
occurrences.quote_span: While the average adult cat weighs about 10 pounds, Susan Rice, a Certified Cat Friendly Veterinarian at Pacific Animal Hospital , said that figure alone cannot determine whether an individual cat is at a healthy weight.
occurrences.speaker: Susan Rice
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: Susan Rice interview and veterinary feline weight-loss records/guidelines
occurrences.quote_span: For a severely overweight cat, she added, it may take up to a year to reach a healthy weight.
occurrences.speaker: Susan Rice
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: Susan Rice interview or veterinary body-condition assessment guidance
occurrences.quote_span: “The easiest way to tell if your cat is overweight is to feel the area over their ribs,” Rice said.
occurrences.speaker: Susan Rice
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: veterinary epidemiological and clinical records on feline obesity complications
occurrences.quote_span: Excess weight can raise a cat’s risk of diabetes, arthritis, skin problems, urinary issues and difficulty grooming.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: Susan Rice interview or veterinary household feeding guidance
occurrences.quote_span: Rice also suggests measuring the cat’s full daily allowance each morning so everyone feeds from the same supply.
occurrences.speaker: Susan Rice
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: veterinary feline weight-management guidelines
occurrences.quote_span: A veterinarian will consider weight, body condition, muscle mass, age, activity level and medical history before recommending a goal weight and daily allowance.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: veterinary studies measuring mobility and activity limitations in overweight cats
occurrences.quote_span: It can also make ordinary cat activities, such as jumping onto a favorite perch, squeezing through the cat door, or a round of midnight hallway zoomies, harder than they should be.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: Susan Rice interview and veterinary feline weight-loss guidelines

figure.unit: percent of body weight per week

occurrences.quote_span: “Cats should lose weight gradually over the course of several months, aiming for about 1% of their body weight per week,” Rice said.
occurrences.speaker: Susan Rice
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: veterinary feline body-condition scoring guidelines
occurrences.quote_span: You may also notice slight bumps over the spine and hips in a cat at a healthy weight, while a flatter back with little noticeable bone structure may suggest your cat is carrying some extra padding.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: controlled feline weight-management studies comparing wet and dry diets
occurrences.quote_span: Neither wet nor dry food guarantees weight loss because total calories matter more than whether dinner comes from a can or a bag.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: cat overweight and weight loss guidance
